text:
Ava: FYI I just saw a spike of 413s from a partner sending mixed-dim batches (some 768, some 256) in one payload. client wanted single-call semantics. anyone seen this pattern recently?
Marcus: saw a few customers try to cram different vector lengths into one /embeddings request. our splitter used to reject but current router is trying to route and hits quota/routing mismatch.
Priya: we should add an early-detect header + tiny preflight to avoid wasted work. e.g. client sends `X-Embed-Shape: dims=256,768; count=24` before payload and we respond with a routing plan. cheap and avoids 413s.
Tom: +1 on header. also propose a deterministic routing decision: prefer same-dim route, else return 422 with suggestion to split or convert, rather than auto-splitting which silently changes semantics.
Ava: agree about not silently mutating. but vendors ask for an "auto-split" fallback toggle in the Console for teams that opt-in and accept semantic changes. toggle would show estimated token cost and latency. :gear:
Marcus: console toggle is fine, but we need telemetry to show how many requests hit fallback and the per-dim split histogram. name metrics `embed.request_shapes`, `embed.split_fallback_count`, `embed.latency_by_dim`.
SRE-Bot: pinging metrics infra: `embed.request_shapes` as label set {dims, count, bytes} is okay, but watch cardinality. suggest bucketing dims: small(<=256), medium(257-1024), large(>1024).
Priya: for the preflight response we can return a tiny JSON plan:
```
{
  "plan_version": "v1",
  "ok": true,
  "routes": [
    {"dims":256, "route":"embed-v1-small", "batch_hint":16},
    {"dims":768, "route":"embed-v1-medium", "batch_hint":8}
  ],
  "suggested_action":"split_or_enable_auto_split"
}
```
Marcus: that plan lets SDKs do client-side split cheaply. SDKs can also optionally send `X-Embed-Accept-Split: true` to allow server-side split which will be charged and audited.
Tom: ops question: how do we handle quota? If server splits a single call into two routes, do we charge both under caller usage? how scoreboard appears in Console?
Ava: charge both; Console should show an expanded line item with split attribution. UX note: show both per-route cost and a consolidated preview to avoid surprises.
Marcus: rollout plan proposal: gate the header+plan behind a feature-flag (ff:embed_preflight_v1) -> enable for small cohort -> surface metrics in a new Console panel (Embeddings > Shape diagnostics) -> enable auto-split toggle per-route.
Priya: also add defensive server-side validation for payload bytes: `max_vector_bytes` per route. if payload > limit return 413 with a human-friendly message and link to Console route settings.
InfraBot: deploy pipeline note: will need a schema bump for API gateway, and a small env var to enable header parsing. I can coordinate canary if we want gradual rollout.
SRE-Bot: alert rule suggestion: if `embed.split_fallback_count` > 0.5% of requests in 5m for a route -> page oncall, because that indicates client errors or bad SDK defaults.
Ava: ok action items: 1) Priya/Tom draft preflight API + error strings (PR by EOD) 2) Marcus add telemetry buckets and dashboard mock 3) InfraBot prepare gateway schema PR 4) Console team: mock toggle + cost preview. I'll create RFC and link to this thread. :thumbsup:
